review_scope: Main agent read every Chinese paragraph in EP16–20 and each proposed Chinese/English correction. Language reviewers read the complete assigned manuscripts and provided exact-coordinate reviews. Root adjudicated internal calculations, technical distinctions, and selected primary court, protocol, and prospectus passages. This is not an exhaustive historical or legal audit. All original sections, examples, paragraph positions, and the August 2026 source cutoff are retained.

edits.zh: 在原生兑换机制里，UST 持有人拿到的不是对独立美元储备的直接请求权，而是同一个风险体系里的 LUNA。后来基金会动用外部资产护盘，并没有把这个原生请求权变成按面值提取美元储备的权利。
edits.en: Under the native conversion mechanism, UST holders did not receive a direct claim against independent dollar reserves; they received LUNA within the same risk system. The foundation’s later use of external assets to defend the peg did not turn that native claim into a right to withdraw dollar reserves at par.
edits.reason: Distinguish the native UST-to-LUNA redemption mechanism from discretionary LFG external reserves. It did not give holders a direct fixed-dollar claim against independent reserves, but the later historical intervention did useBTC/USDT/USDC. Do not say there were no external reserves anywhere in the episode.

edits.zh: 第八篇里写过两条法币储备型稳定币的路。那两条路上的储备，是短期国债、隔夜回购、银行存款这些外部资产，背后还有一家可以被起诉的发行方；直接赎回仍受资格和条款限制。
edits.en: Essay 8 described two reserve-backed stablecoin routes. Their reserves consisted of external assets such as short-term Treasuries, overnight repos, and bank deposits, with an issuer that could be sued. Direct redemption still depended on eligibility and terms.
edits.reason: Distinguish the native UST-to-LUNA redemption mechanism from discretionary LFG external reserves. It did not give holders a direct fixed-dollar claim against independent reserves, but the later historical intervention did useBTC/USDT/USDC. Do not say there were no external reserves anywhere in the episode.

edits.zh: 而这一次，原生兑换的核心支点是体系自己的 LUNA，而不是一笔可由每个持有人直接按面值提取的外部储备。
edits.en: Here, the native conversion mechanism’s central support was the system’s own LUNA, not external reserves that every holder could directly withdraw at par.
edits.reason: Distinguish the native UST-to-LUNA redemption mechanism from discretionary LFG external reserves. It did not give holders a direct fixed-dollar claim against independent reserves, but the later historical intervention did useBTC/USDT/USDC. Do not say there were no external reserves anywhere in the episode.

edits.zh: 按预言机报价计算，1 枚 UST 对应名义价值 1 美元的 LUNA，是那套兑换机制的基准；实际收到多少，还要看动态价差、参数和当时能否执行兑换。
edits.en: At the oracle price, one UST corresponding to a nominal dollar’s worth of LUNA was the conversion mechanism’s reference point. What was actually received also depended on dynamic spreads, parameters, and whether conversion was operating at the time.
edits.reason: Native conversion used dynamic spreads, parameters changed, and chain halts later stopped the route. Do not turn nominal oracle-priced conversion into an uninterrupted never-changed promise. Supply and reserve movements were observable risk indicators; no on-chain indicator changed is too broad, especially in Spanish.

edits.zh: 一个按预言机报价计算的兑换机制，可以仍在依公式执行，而在经济上已经失去支撑。满足那道计算，并不等于换来的资产真能在市场上卖出相应金额；这还需要另查市场价格和流动性。
edits.en: A conversion mechanism based on oracle prices can continue applying its formula after its economic support has failed. Satisfying that calculation does not mean the received assets can actually be sold for the corresponding sum; market prices and liquidity must be checked separately.
edits.reason: Native conversion used dynamic spreads, parameters changed, and chain halts later stopped the route. Do not turn nominal oracle-priced conversion into an uninterrupted never-changed promise. Supply and reserve movements were observable risk indicators; no on-chain indicator changed is too broad, especially in Spanish.

edits.zh: 第六篇里那次分叉，争的是链该不该按人的意思改；第十一篇里那次清算，合约可以按规则结算，却没有足够的报价竞争。这一次又露出一道缝：名义兑换继续计算，并不保证持有人能拿回一美元的购买力。
edits.en: The fork in Essay 6 concerned whether people should change the chain’s outcome. In Essay 11, auctions could settle under the rules without sufficient bidding competition. Here another gap appeared: continuing nominal conversion calculations did not guarantee that holders could recover a dollar’s purchasing power.
edits.reason: Native conversion used dynamic spreads, parameters changed, and chain halts later stopped the route. Do not turn nominal oracle-priced conversion into an uninterrupted never-changed promise. Supply and reserve movements were observable risk indicators; no on-chain indicator changed is too broad, especially in Spanish.

edits.zh: 而这并不是说链上没有预警指标。供应量、兑换压力和储备调动都可能留下可查的变化；只是那条名义兑换公式本身，不能替人判断整个体系还能不能承受这些压力。
edits.en: This does not mean the chain lacked warning indicators. Supply, conversion pressure, and reserve movements could leave observable changes. The nominal conversion formula itself simply could not decide whether the wider system could still bear that pressure.
edits.reason: Native conversion used dynamic spreads, parameters changed, and chain halts later stopped the route. Do not turn nominal oracle-priced conversion into an uninterrupted never-changed promise. Supply and reserve movements were observable risk indicators; no on-chain indicator changed is too broad, especially in Spanish.

edits.zh: 而这个比例是看收益缺口的重要入口，却不能单凭它断言借款利率无论多高都不够。要把近 20% 的存款承诺接住，必须把实际借款利息、抵押品收益和其他收入加起来；不足的那一部分，才需要储备或补贴填上。
edits.en: That ratio is an important starting point for examining the yield gap, but it cannot by itself prove that no borrowing rate could cover it. To support the roughly 20% deposit promise, actual borrowing interest, collateral yields, and other income must be added together. Any remaining shortfall requires reserves or subsidies.
edits.reason: Deposit/loan ratio4.7 alone cannot prove any borrowing rate would be insufficient: sufficiently large lending/staking earnings could mathematically cover deposit yield. Ground the gap in observed rates, collateral yields and income, not the ratio alone. Peak balances are not demonstrated daily ratios for the entire prior history.

edits.zh: 这是一道算术，但要把实际收益率和收入一并放进去；它不需要先判断谁的动机。
edits.en: It is an arithmetic question, but actual yields and income must enter the calculation. It does not first require a judgment about anyone’s motives.
edits.reason: Deposit/loan ratio4.7 alone cannot prove any borrowing rate would be insufficient: sufficiently large lending/staking earnings could mathematically cover deposit yield. Ground the gap in observed rates, collateral yields and income, not the ratio alone. Peak balances are not demonstrated daily ratios for the entire prior history.

edits.zh: 公开的存借款余额让人能够追问这道缺口。要说崩盘之前每一天差多少，还需要各天的余额、收益和补贴记录，不能只拿临近崩盘的两个数替整段历史作答。
edits.en: Public deposit and loan balances made that gap examinable. Establishing its size on every day before the collapse would require daily balances, income, and subsidy records, not just two figures close to the collapse.
edits.reason: Deposit/loan ratio4.7 alone cannot prove any borrowing rate would be insufficient: sufficiently large lending/staking earnings could mathematically cover deposit yield. Ground the gap in observed rates, collateral yields and income, not the ratio alone. Peak balances are not demonstrated daily ratios for the entire prior history.

edits.zh: 后来被认定不实的，是把那次恢复描绘成无需隐蔽外部支持、单靠算法完成的成绩单，而不是价格曾经恢复这件事本身。
edits.en: What was later found misleading was the portrayal of that recovery as an algorithmic success without concealed outside support, not the fact that the price had recovered.
edits.reason: What proved false was the claim of autonomous algorithmic recovery without secret external support, not the occurrence of the2021peg recovery itself.

edits.zh: 这里又出现了验证者主动停链。它和第六篇那次通过分叉更改状态不是同一种操作，也不是这个系列第一次遇到停机：第十五篇已写过 BNB Chain 的暂停。这一次，停下来的直接理由，是防止新铸出的巨量 LUNA 让攻击者以极低成本控制治理。
edits.en: Here validators actively halted a chain. That was not the same operation as changing state through the fork in Essay 6, nor the first halt in this series: Essay 15 already discussed BNB Chain’s pause. The immediate reason here was to prevent the enormous supply of newly minted LUNA from making governance control cheap for an attacker.
edits.reason: The2016DAO state-changing hard fork was not an Ethereum validator shutdown before modifying state. This series already discussed BNB halting, so calling Terra the second such event is also inconsistent. Contrast fork and halt without ordinal counting.

edits.zh: 这个结果也说明了为什么只看总市值损失看不到分配问题：最先退出的人，把 UST 换给了后来承接的人，或者换给了基金会和项目方的防守盘。较早退出者更有机会取得接近 1 美元的资产；越晚的人，往往面对越深的折价和越猛烈的稀释。
edits.en: This also shows why aggregate market-value loss misses distribution. Earlier exiters transferred UST to later buyers or to the foundation’s and project’s defensive purchases. Earlier exit gave a better chance of receiving assets closer to one dollar; later participants often faced deeper discounts and more intense dilution.
edits.reason: Use lower prices or larger discounts, not lower discounts, for later exits facing a worsening depeg.

edits.zh: 同一份链上数据，到了不同人手里，未必变成同样可用的机会。资金规模、工具、交易通道和反应速度，都会影响他能否趁流动性还在时退出；这不能简化成大户一定卖得掉、小户只能看着。
edits.en: The same on-chain data need not become an equally usable opportunity in different hands. Capital, tools, trading access, and response speed can affect whether someone exits while liquidity remains. That is not the same as saying large holders can always sell and small holders can only watch.
edits.reason: Average earlier exits/lower losses among wealthier sophisticated participants do not imply large holders can always immediately sell hundreds of millions while small holders can only watch. Public visibility does not guarantee no inside information, latency or priority channels; this essay also describes alleged nonpublic-information advantages. Preserve empirical distributional finding without deterministic wealth-based abilities.

edits.zh: 透明确实让一部分账本信息对所有人公开。但公开同一份数据，不等于没有内幕、没有延迟差异、没有特权通道，也不保证每个人同样看得懂、用得上。
edits.en: Transparency did make part of the ledger public to everyone. Publishing the same data does not mean there was no inside information, no latency difference, or no privileged channel; nor does it guarantee equal ability to understand and use the data.
edits.reason: Average earlier exits/lower losses among wealthier sophisticated participants do not imply large holders can always immediately sell hundreds of millions while small holders can only watch. Public visibility does not guarantee no inside information, latency or priority channels; this essay also describes alleged nonpublic-information advantages. Preserve empirical distributional finding without deterministic wealth-based abilities.

edits.zh: 对一些有工具、有通道、有充足流动性的人，它可能成为可以执行的信号；对另一些人，它可能只是看得见却很难及时行动的消息。区别不能只用持仓金额解释。
edits.en: For some people with tools, access, and adequate liquidity, the information could become an actionable signal. For others, it might be visible but difficult to act on in time. Position size alone cannot explain the difference.
edits.reason: Average earlier exits/lower losses among wealthier sophisticated participants do not imply large holders can always immediately sell hundreds of millions while small holders can only watch. Public visibility does not guarantee no inside information, latency or priority channels; this essay also describes alleged nonpublic-information advantages. Preserve empirical distributional finding without deterministic wealth-based abilities.

edits.zh: 而它们也说明了一件总额里看不见的事：那笔钱在崩盘之前的用途，和它在崩盘之后留下的东西，是两样不同的东西。一笔准备用来租房的押金，可能缩成了无法再完成原来用途的余额；租房这件事仍然要办。
edits.en: They also show something an aggregate misses: what the money was for before the collapse differs from what remained afterward. Savings intended for a housing deposit could shrink to a balance no longer sufficient for that purpose. The need for housing remained.
edits.reason: The quoted household losses do not necessarily establish every relevant housing deposit became exactly zero. Say savings shrank or could no longer fulfill their housing purpose without inventing total depletion.

edits.zh: 而把这三个数字混用，后果很具体：一个损失了钱的人读到 44.74 亿，会以为有这么大的资金池等着分。实际可供分配的规模，要看约 1.8 亿到 4.4 亿的资产实现估计，以及最终获准的债权、优先次序和分配方案；一万六千多份申报，不是把钱平均分掉的除数。
edits.en: Mixing those three numbers has a concrete consequence: someone who lost money may read $4.474 billion as a pool waiting to be distributed. The amount actually available depends on estimated asset realization of roughly $180 million to $440 million, allowed claims, priorities, and the distribution plan. More than sixteen thousand filings are not a divisor for equal payments.
edits.reason: Actual distributions depend on allowed claims, claim amounts, priority and plan rules, not equal division by the count of submitted claims. Count is not an approved unique-person denominator.

edits.zh: 另一方面，识别风险不等于当时已经有明确、可执行的法律工具，足以要求这项产品具备相应的外部储备、约束承诺收益，或者直接叫停它。这要看具体法域、产品定性和监管权限，而不是拿一般银行也未必适用的百分之百美元准备金作比较。
edits.en: Recognizing risk does not establish that clear, enforceable legal tools then existed to require adequate external reserves for this product, constrain its promised yield, or stop it. That depends on jurisdiction, legal classification, and regulatory powers—not a comparison with a 100% dollar-reserve requirement that does not generally apply to banks either.
edits.reason: Do not imply ordinary banks generally face100%dollar cash-reserve requirements. Ask whether regulators had clear authority to impose adequate external reserve requirements on this product without the general-bank comparison.

edits.zh: 第八篇那两条路，以外部资产支持约定的赎回；这一次，原生兑换机制倚靠体系自己的 LUNA。基金会另行调动外部资产护盘，并没有改变两者的核心区别。
edits.en: The two routes in Essay 8 backed their stated redemption with external assets. Here the native conversion mechanism relied on the system’s own LUNA. The foundation’s separate deployment of external assets to defend the peg did not erase that distinction.
edits.reason: Synchronize caveats: native oracle-valued conversion was subject to spreads and operational availability, not guaranteed full-dollar receipts every time from inception. Chain halts and parameter changes are explicitly recorded above; market quotes did not universally cease. Contrast nominal computation and realizable proceeds without zero-failure/all-time guarantees.

edits.zh: 在兑换通道可用时，协议按预言机报价计算 UST 对应的 LUNA，再受动态价差等参数约束。后来验证者暂停出块，参数也被调整；不能把这段过程写成从未中断的一美元兑付。
edits.en: While conversion was available, the protocol calculated the LUNA corresponding to UST at oracle prices, subject to dynamic spreads and other parameters. Validators later halted block production, and parameters changed. This was not uninterrupted one-dollar redemption.
edits.reason: Synchronize caveats: native oracle-valued conversion was subject to spreads and operational availability, not guaranteed full-dollar receipts every time from inception. Chain halts and parameter changes are explicitly recorded above; market quotes did not universally cease. Contrast nominal computation and realizable proceeds without zero-failure/all-time guarantees.

edits.zh: 从上线到崩盘，名义计算并没有保证持有人每一次都能拿回一美元，更没有保证把换来的 LUNA 在市场上卖出同样的金额。
edits.en: From launch to collapse, the nominal calculation did not guarantee that holders would recover one dollar every time, much less sell the LUNA received for the same amount in the market.
edits.reason: Synchronize caveats: native oracle-valued conversion was subject to spreads and operational availability, not guaranteed full-dollar receipts every time from inception. Chain halts and parameter changes are explicitly recorded above; market quotes did not universally cease. Contrast nominal computation and realizable proceeds without zero-failure/all-time guarantees.

edits.zh: 那条账面基准，和真正能拿到手的价值，并不是同一句话。
edits.en: The accounting reference point and the value actually realizable were not the same statement.
edits.reason: Synchronize caveats: native oracle-valued conversion was subject to spreads and operational availability, not guaranteed full-dollar receipts every time from inception. Chain halts and parameter changes are explicitly recorded above; market quotes did not universally cease. Contrast nominal computation and realizable proceeds without zero-failure/all-time guarantees.

edits.zh: 它也不只在协议之外。价差、容量、预言机和停机都属于必须一并看的条件；公式能够算出一笔兑换，不等于体系实现了持有人期待的一美元结果。
edits.en: Nor did the gap lie wholly outside the protocol. Spreads, capacity, oracles, and halts were all relevant conditions. Computing a conversion did not mean the system delivered the dollar outcome holders expected.
edits.reason: Synchronize caveats: native oracle-valued conversion was subject to spreads and operational availability, not guaranteed full-dollar receipts every time from inception. Chain halts and parameter changes are explicitly recorded above; market quotes did not universally cease. Contrast nominal computation and realizable proceeds without zero-failure/all-time guarantees.

edits.zh: 三月里，这两件事常常显得很接近；到崩盘时，名义价值与市场上真正能变现的金额越走越远。报价并非全都消失了，而是在剧烈波动、流动性衰退和通道受限中，那个名义上的一美元越来越难兑现。
edits.en: In March, the two could often appear close. During the collapse, nominal value and realizable market proceeds moved farther apart. Quotes did not all disappear; amid volatility, deteriorating liquidity, and restricted access, that nominal dollar became increasingly difficult to realize.
edits.reason: Synchronize caveats: native oracle-valued conversion was subject to spreads and operational availability, not guaranteed full-dollar receipts every time from inception. Chain halts and parameter changes are explicitly recorded above; market quotes did not universally cease. Contrast nominal computation and realizable proceeds without zero-failure/all-time guarantees.

edits.zh: 那几天里，链曾继续出块，也曾被验证者暂停；出块本身没有把市场支撑找回来。
edits.en: During those days, the chain both continued producing blocks and was halted by validators. Block production itself did not restore market support.
edits.reason: Synchronize caveats: native oracle-valued conversion was subject to spreads and operational availability, not guaranteed full-dollar receipts every time from inception. Chain halts and parameter changes are explicitly recorded above; market quotes did not universally cease. Contrast nominal computation and realizable proceeds without zero-failure/all-time guarantees.

edits.zh: 已执行的兑换和新铸的 LUNA 留下了可追踪的账本记录。但能逐笔查到，不等于每一笔都保住了持有人想要的一美元。
edits.en: Executed conversions and newly minted LUNA left traceable ledger records. Being able to inspect them transaction by transaction did not mean that each preserved the dollar holders wanted.
edits.reason: Synchronize caveats: native oracle-valued conversion was subject to spreads and operational availability, not guaranteed full-dollar receipts every time from inception. Chain halts and parameter changes are explicitly recorded above; market quotes did not universally cease. Contrast nominal computation and realizable proceeds without zero-failure/all-time guarantees.

edits.zh: 而余项就在这三组人之间的那两条分界线上。它不只是一笔尚未追到的钱。后来的调查重建了大量资金流，记录很细；但把资金流追清楚，也不会自动抹去这三组人承担损失的不同位置。
edits.en: The remainder lies along the two boundaries between these three groups. It is not simply money not yet traced. Later investigations reconstructed extensive fund flows in detail, but tracing those flows does not automatically erase the groups’ different positions in bearing losses.
edits.reason: Do not certify that every payment was fully reconstructed; retain the distinction between traceability and loss-bearing positions.

edits.zh: 一条区分犯罪与合法，由法院审理，已经形成定罪、量刑等裁判；相关上诉与其他后续事项仍要分别看。
edits.en: One line distinguishes criminal from lawful conduct. Courts had already entered convictions and sentences; appeals and other subsequent matters still required separate attention.
edits.reason: Criminal adjudication does more than decide imprisonment: this essay discusses forfeiture, loss assessment and appellate issues. Distinguish criminal responsibility from bankruptcy valuation/distribution without saying the first only imprisons or all its work is finished, or asserting bankruptcy necessarily matters more.

edits.zh: 另一条画在 2022 年11 月11 日，由破产程序处理。对债权人来说，它决定的是另一件同样切身的事。
edits.en: The other falls on November 11, 2022, and is administered through bankruptcy. For creditors, it determines a different matter that is also deeply personal.
edits.reason: Criminal adjudication does more than decide imprisonment: this essay discusses forfeiture, loss assessment and appellate issues. Distinguish criminal responsibility from bankruptcy valuation/distribution without saying the first only imprisons or all its work is finished, or asserting bankruptcy necessarily matters more.

edits.zh: 刑事程序处理责任、刑罚、没收等问题；破产程序在这里决定，数百万账户里的债权如何估值、如何分配，以及此后币价变化通过什么方式影响各方。两者不能互相代替。
edits.en: Criminal proceedings address responsibility, punishment, forfeiture, and related issues. Here bankruptcy determines how claims across millions of accounts are valued and distributed, and how later token-price changes affect the parties. Neither process substitutes for the other.
edits.reason: Criminal adjudication does more than decide imprisonment: this essay discusses forfeiture, loss assessment and appellate issues. Distinguish criminal responsibility from bankruptcy valuation/distribution without saying the first only imprisons or all its work is finished, or asserting bankruptcy necessarily matters more.

edits.zh: 回购销毁这件事在当时被广泛当作一个优点：一个交易所把自己的收入拿去买回并销毁自己的代币，看上去像是把持币者和平台的利益绑在一起。
edits.en: Buybacks and burns were widely treated as a virtue at the time. An exchange using its revenue to buy and burn its own token appeared to tie token holders’ interests to the platform.
edits.reason: FTT token holders are not thereby shareholders; preserve the perceived incentive alignment without giving the token equity rights.

edits.zh: 而这个集团的监管覆盖和实际隔离安排，并不像传统受严格监管的客户资产体系那样完整。这不等于其多数实体完全没有合同、财产法或反欺诈上的义务。
edits.en: The group’s regulatory coverage and actual segregation arrangements were not as comprehensive as those in a strictly regulated traditional customer-asset system. That does not mean most entities had no contractual, property-law, or anti-fraud duties at all.
edits.reason: Lack of traditional licensing/consolidated regulation does not itself prove absence of all contractual, trust/property-law or anti-fraud customer-asset duties. Narrow to missing regulatory coverage and actual segregation controls unless precise jurisdiction-specific exemption is established.

edits.zh: 这个区分不是替谁开脱。把它描述成按钮还是账户参数，都不能替已经被认定的挪用行为免责；具体刑事责任仍由行为、证据和适用法律决定。
edits.en: This distinction excuses no one. Describing the mechanism as a button or account parameters does not absolve established misuse of funds. Criminal responsibility still turns on conduct, evidence, and applicable law.
edits.reason: Do not assert two hypothetical technical descriptions necessarily have identical criminal consequences independent of statutory elements and evidence. The point is that correcting the mechanism's description does not excuse the established fraud.

edits.zh: 而它改变了外部调查应当追什么。一个特殊按钮值得查，一组藏在日常风控配置里的关联方特权也值得查。参数写在系统里，不表示审计必然看不见；但如果拿不到完整权限表、对账和关联方数据，外部观察者很难只靠正常运行的表象发现它。
edits.en: It changes what an outside investigation should examine. A special button deserves scrutiny, but so do related-party privileges embedded in ordinary risk settings. Parameters within the system are not inherently invisible to an audit. Without complete permission tables, reconciliation, and related-party data, however, outside observers cannot easily discover them from the appearance of normal operation.
edits.reason: Exceptional permissions inside a legitimate configuration system can still be found by examining related-party privileges and reconciliation. Avoid asserting parameters inherently look normal to audits or a hidden button is necessarily easier to discover. Explain limits of outside public evidence rather than impossibility of audit detection.

edits.zh: 他认罪的两项是违法政治捐款和无牌汇款。这与其他人承认的客户资金挪用等罪名需要区分，不能因此说这一组人里只有他的认罪涉及其他类型的犯罪。
edits.en: His two admitted counts concerned unlawful political contributions and unlicensed money transmission. They should be distinguished from customer-fund misappropriation and other counts admitted by others, without implying that he alone pleaded guilty to other kinds of offenses.
edits.reason: Check claim that Salame alone had admitted charges outside customer-fund misappropriation: Singh's six-count plea appears also to include conspiracy to make unlawful political contributions. Avoid uniqueness until verified.

edits.zh: 所以这一组刑期不是一张按罪行大小排列的表。合作的价值是重要因素，而合作价值又取决于谁先开口，谁能提供别人提供不了的东西；不同指控、角色和其他量刑因素，也不能从这张表里抹掉。
edits.en: These sentences are not a table ranking the size of crimes. Cooperation mattered greatly, including who spoke first and who could provide otherwise unavailable evidence. Different charges, roles, and other sentencing factors cannot be erased from the comparison either.
edits.reason: Cooperation is an important sentencing factor, not a sufficient single-axis explanation of every sentence.

edits.zh: 后来能收回多少钱，和当时客户的钱被怎样占用，是两个不同时点的问题。上诉法院 2026 年的处理，正是拒绝用事后回收或资产升值，抵销当时已经发生的欺诈。
edits.en: How much could later be recovered and how customer funds were used at the time are questions at different dates. The appellate court’s 2026 decision refused to let later recoveries or asset appreciation cancel fraud that had already occurred.
edits.reason: Fix reversed former/latter logic and match the appellate distinction between fraud and later recovery.

edits.zh: 而收款日，要看他所属的分配批次，不能拿查询累计比例的日期替代。便利债权类别从 2025 年 2 月就开始分配；并不是每个人都等到了距 2022 年 11 月 11 日三年多的时候。
edits.en: The receipt date depends on the person’s distribution batch, not the date when cumulative percentages are consulted. Convenience-class distributions began in February 2025; not everyone waited more than three years after November 11, 2022.
edits.reason: The one-BTC example is a convenience claim; the essay itself dates first distributions to February2025. A later aggregate reporting date is not an individual receipt date.

edits.zh: 材料能支持的窄版本是：到 2026 年 7 月，某些已经获准的债权类别，公开列示的累计分配比例为申请日美元债权的 103% 到 120%。个人是否已经到账，还要看资格审核、所属批次和实际收款情况。
edits.en: The narrower version supported by the material is that, by July 2026, publicly listed cumulative distribution percentages for certain allowed claim classes ranged from 103% to 120% of petition-date dollar claims. Individual receipt still depended on eligibility checks, the relevant batch, and actual payment.
edits.reason: Distinguish published cumulative class distribution percentages from every individual creditor actually having received funds.

edits.zh: 这个比例能超过一百，直接原因是获准美元本金之外，还计入了按方案支付的利息等金额。申请日较低的币价，解释的是为什么百分比看起来很高，债权人却仍未恢复后来那些币的经济价值；这是另一层比较。
edits.en: The ratio exceeds one hundred directly because the plan adds interest and other amounts to allowed dollar principal. Depressed token prices at the petition date explain a different comparison: why a high percentage can still leave creditors short of the later economic value of their tokens.
edits.reason: Nominal payout exceeding100% directly reflects plan interest/other allowed additions. A low petition-date price explains the gap against later coin values, not independently why the ratio of payout to that same dollar principal exceeds100%. Separate these two effects.

edits.zh: 自己发行的资产又被拿来支撑关联方借款，会把发行人、抵押品和借款人的风险绑在一起。传统金融对关联交易、资本和集中风险有多种约束；这里要追问的，是这个集团当时的合并监管、信息披露和实际控制，为什么没有把这些风险接起来。
edits.en: Using a self-issued asset to support related-party borrowing binds together the risks of issuer, collateral, and borrower. Traditional finance has various constraints on related-party transactions, capital, and concentration. The question here is why the group’s consolidated supervision, disclosures, and actual controls did not connect those risks.
edits.reason: Regulator would immediately stop a bank's self-issued collateral and no rules covered the group are broad legal/counterfactual claims. Existing legal prohibitions are distinct from consolidated supervision or detection. Prefer narrower observed related-party/self-referential collateral weaknesses.

edits.zh: 前者有结构性的原因：这里没有上市金融机构那样完整、定期、可公开核验的储备和关联方数据；这不等于私人公司完全没有披露义务。后者是判断问题：在拿不到独立数据的情况下，应当写得更谨慎一些。
edits.en: The first has a structural aspect: there was no full set of periodic, publicly checkable reserve and related-party data comparable to that of a listed financial institution. That does not mean private companies have no disclosure duties at all. The second concerns judgment: without independent data, reporting should be more cautious.
edits.reason: Private-company status does not universally mean no disclosure duties at all. Restrict to absence of listed-bank-style public periodic reserve/related-party/segment data in this case, without denying investor, regulator or contractual disclosures.

edits.zh: 它不是一样被漏掉的东西。作为计量单位，1 枚仍然是 1 枚，比特币可以精确到聪；但这不表示平台一直完整保有每个客户原来的币。
edits.en: It is not something overlooked. As a unit of account, one coin remains one coin, and bitcoin can be measured to the satoshi. That does not mean the platform continuously retained every customer’s original coins in full.
edits.reason: One coin remained one coin is a unit identity, not proof every customer coin quantity stayed unchanged on-chain. This case's petition-date dollar valuation should not be universalized to every insolvency procedure; alternative in-kind routes are already discussed. November11was a depressed market date, not necessarily the absolute market low.

edits.zh: 而这个破产程序，采用申请日的美元估值，把大量账户、多种代币和衍生品债权放到共同的比较基础上。其他案件是否返还原币、采用什么估值和分配安排，还要分别看。
edits.en: This bankruptcy proceeding used petition-date dollar valuations to put claims across many accounts, tokens, and derivatives on a common basis. Whether another case returns assets in kind, and how it values and distributes claims, must be examined separately.
edits.reason: One coin remained one coin is a unit identity, not proof every customer coin quantity stayed unchanged on-chain. This case's petition-date dollar valuation should not be universalized to every insolvency procedure; alternative in-kind routes are already discussed. November11was a depressed market date, not necessarily the absolute market low.

edits.zh: 这是一种法律上的归类和分配选择，有它适用的规则，也有可以争论的后果；不是所有破产程序都必须采用完全相同的做法。
edits.en: This is a legal choice about classification and distribution, governed by applicable rules and carrying consequences that can be debated. Not every bankruptcy must take the identical approach.
edits.reason: One coin remained one coin is a unit identity, not proof every customer coin quantity stayed unchanged on-chain. This case's petition-date dollar valuation should not be universalized to every insolvency procedure; alternative in-kind routes are already discussed. November11was a depressed market date, not necessarily the absolute market low.

edits.zh: 而申请日之后的资产升值先反映在破产财团那一侧；债权人按方案分配所依据的，是申请日固定的美元债权，再加相应利息等金额，而不是自动恢复原来的币价敞口。
edits.en: Post-petition appreciation first appears on the estate’s side. Distributions to creditors under the plan are based on dollar claims fixed at the petition date, plus the applicable interest and other amounts—not an automatic restoration of their original token-price exposure.
edits.reason: One coin remained one coin is a unit identity, not proof every customer coin quantity stayed unchanged on-chain. This case's petition-date dollar valuation should not be universalized to every insolvency procedure; alternative in-kind routes are already discussed. November11was a depressed market date, not necessarily the absolute market low.

edits.zh: 以太坊保留了原有的执行状态和虚拟机，把区块生产、分叉选择和最终确定转交给信标链的验证者，结束了工作量证明矿工参与这条主链共识的阶段；由此同时终止了原有的工作量证明挖矿发行和这条链自身的大规模算力能耗需求，并把安全预算、最大可提取价值、资本门槛、集中度和监管争论，转移到质押、验证服务和区块构建这一组新的制度与市场结构上。
edits.en: Ethereum retained its existing execution state and virtual machine while handing block production, fork choice, and finalization to Beacon Chain validators, ending proof-of-work miners' role in this main chain's consensus. It ended the former proof-of-work mining issuance stream and the chain's own demand for large-scale computational energy, while moving security-budget, maximal-extractable-value, capital-threshold, concentration, and regulatory debates into a new set of institutions and market structures: staking, validation services, and block construction.
edits.reason: Specify PoW issuance ceased, not every issuance stream; avoid implying PoW had identical explicit finality mechanics.

edits.zh: 当时用于估算权益证明能耗的是已经运行的信标链，执行交易的主网仍采用工作量证明。作者观察了约 140,592 个验证者和 16,405 个独立存款地址，再剔除已知的交易所与服务商地址，然后假设一个家庭质押者平均运行约 5.4 个验证者；家庭节点采用约 100 瓦除以 5.4 个验证者的保守硬件假设，再加入托管运营商，最后估出整个权益证明网络约 2.62 兆瓦。
edits.en: The proof-of-stake system being modeled was the already operating Beacon Chain; the transaction-executing mainnet still used proof of work. The author observed approximately 140,592 validators and 16,405 distinct deposit addresses, removed known exchange and service-provider addresses, and assumed an average home staker ran approximately 5.4 validators. A conservative home-node hardware assumption divided approximately 100 watts by 5.4 validators. Adding hosted operators produced an estimate of approximately 2.62 megawatts for the whole proof-of-stake network.
edits.reason: Only Beacon existed is incorrect without limiting the scope to the modeled PoS system.

edits.zh: 工作量证明的能耗也一直需要估计：算力可以从区块时间和难度推算，矿机厂商公布设备功耗，矿场也有实际电表；但要从这些材料推到全球总量，仍然要假设机器的组合、使用率和所在地。
edits.en: Proof-of-work energy use also required estimation: hash power could be inferred from block timing and difficulty, manufacturers published machine power specifications, and mining sites had electricity meters. Turning those sources into a global total still required assumptions about equipment mix, utilization, and location.
edits.reason: Do not retrospectively turn PoW modeled totals into direct global meter readings.

edits.zh: 权益证明需要换一组假设：多少个验证者共用一台机器，机器实际消耗多少瓦，托管与家庭节点怎样组合。服务器同样有功耗规格和电表，难的是把分散运行的硬件和负荷完整对应起来，而不是完全没有可测量的基础。
edits.en: Proof of stake requires a different set of assumptions: how many validators share a machine, how much power it actually uses, and how hosted and home nodes are combined. Servers also have power specifications and electricity meters. The difficulty is completely mapping distributed hardware and workloads, not the absence of any measurable basis.
edits.reason: PoS has measurable hardware and electricity too; remove no-anchors-at-all binary.

edits.zh: 能耗没有消失。估计它所需要的模型换了。
edits.en: Energy use did not disappear. The model needed to estimate it changed.
edits.reason: Both systems already required energy models.

edits.zh: 变了的是数字背后的推算方式。过去要估专用矿机和它们的用电，现在还要估一台通用机器承载多少验证任务、用了多少额外电力。两者都有可以核对的部分，也都有链上记录本身不能提供的输入。
edits.en: What changed was the calculation behind the number. Previously it required estimates of specialized mining machines and their electricity use. Now it also requires estimates of how many validation duties a general-purpose machine carries and how much additional power they consume. Both have checkable components and inputs that on-chain records alone cannot supply.
edits.reason: Avoid externally checkable old data versus purely assumed new data as an absolute contrast.

edits.zh: 要精确量出全网验证者的能耗，需要知道实际运行了多少台机器、各是什么配置、放在哪里、有没有跑别的任务；验证者数量也不等于机器数量。这些信息不会自动写在链上，本文所用材料没有提供一份完整的全球硬件与用电普查。可以做调查和抽样，却不能把缺少这份普查说成任何机构都无权收集资料。
edits.en: Precisely measuring network-wide validator energy use would require knowing how many machines actually run, their configurations and locations, and whether they perform other tasks. Validator count is not machine count. This information is not automatically recorded on-chain, and the material used here supplies no complete global hardware-and-energy census. Surveys and sampling are possible; lacking such a census does not establish that no institution has authority to collect information.
edits.reason: Remove unsupported no-collection-authority claim and validator/machine conflation.

edits.zh: 所以，目前引用的这个全网总量仍然是模型估计，不是一场完整的全网实测。这不会使它变得不重要；只是引用时，不能把估算写成直接测量。
edits.en: The network-wide total cited here is therefore still a model estimate, not a complete direct measurement of the network. That does not make it unimportant; it means an estimate should not be cited as a direct measurement.
edits.reason: Carry the preceding corrected survey/model distinction into its concluding sentence; no claim of permanent impossibility of measurement.

edits.zh: 2023 年8 月末，一家数据商把它定义的流动性质押协议相加，报道占比为 43.7%，同时列出约 1,130 万枚对 2,640 万枚。后两项约数直接相除约为 42.8%，和报道占比并不完全一致；在原始时点和口径没有对齐之前，不能把三者当作同一个精确算式。
edits.en: In late August 2023, a data provider summed the protocols it defined as liquid staking and reported a 43.7% share, while also listing approximately 11.3 million out of 26.4 million ETH. Those two rounded quantities divide to about 42.8%, not the reported percentage. Until the original timing and definitions are aligned, the three should not be presented as one exact calculation.
edits.reason: Expose arithmetic mismatch without inventing which primary input should be replaced.

edits.zh: 这不能直接读成资本在四个月里净流出了 6.7 个百分点。交易所发行的流动性代币算不算流动性质押，质押池与流动性质押协议如何分类，不同材料未必一致；实际份额和总质押分母也可能变化。没有重跑原始数据，不能把差额全归给其中一个原因。
edits.en: This cannot directly be read as a net 6.7 percentage points of capital leaving in four months. Sources may differ on whether exchange-issued liquid tokens count as liquid staking and on how staking pools and liquid-staking protocols are classified. Actual shares and the total-stake denominator can also change. Without rerunning the original data, the entire difference cannot be assigned to one explanation.
edits.reason: Noncomparability does not prove all change is classification drift.

edits.zh: 这是这个系列里特别清楚的一次口径漂移。同一个日期的网络活动，在不同统计范围和定义下，被两个页面写成相差约三十二个百分点的比例。它们不宜被当成对同一个分母的精确测量。
edits.en: This is an especially clear shift in measurement definitions. Network activity for the same date appeared on two pages as percentages roughly thirty-two points apart, using different scopes and definitions. They should not be treated as precise measurements of a single denominator.
edits.reason: 94.8 minus63 equals31.8 percentage points; avoid asserting identical underlying samples.

edits.zh: 到 2025 年2 月，该案被撤回，并以不得就相同请求重新起诉的方式结案。案件结束了，而并没有一项就实体问题作出的判决，判定那项服务当年的法律性质。
edits.en: By February 2025, that case had been withdrawn and dismissed with prejudice, barring refiling of the same claims. It ended without a merits ruling determining the service's legal character at the time.
edits.reason: With prejudice is a legal disposition, not biased handling.

edits.zh: 前半句可以按协议与区块记录确认。后半句则必须把每一项经济、能耗和集中度判断拆开，分别核对它的模型、时点和口径。
edits.en: The first half can be checked against the protocol and block records. The second requires each economic, energy, and concentration claim to be examined separately, with its model, date, and measurement definition intact.
edits.reason: Different measurement evidence is not inherently incapable of confirmation.

edits.zh: 能耗估计换了一套模型。集中压力换了位置。最大可提取价值形成了新的区块构建供应链。部分审查问题落在构建者和中继器的政策上。主网的执行区块收入改由验证者领取，而原先支付给工作量证明矿工的那股发行终止了。
edits.en: Energy estimation acquired a different model. Concentration pressures moved. Extractable value formed a new block-building supply chain. Some censorship questions rested with builder and relay policies. Execution-block income on mainnet went to validators, while the issuance stream formerly paid to proof-of-work miners ended.
edits.reason: Do not imply energy first became modeled, all censorship is relay policy, or the full old mining reward stream simply moved unchanged to stakers.

edits.zh: 而在新的位置，每一样都要重新说明怎样量；其中一些，也变得更难从公开记录里直接看清。
edits.en: In their new locations, each requires a fresh account of how it is measured. Some also become harder to see directly in public records.
edits.reason: Avoid unsupported claim that every dimension necessarily became harder to measure.

edits.zh: 这不必归因于有人隐瞒。旧系统的电、机器和算力也没有一张天然完整的总表；新系统又多了质押服务、构建者、组织和合同。换了角色之后，原来的读数不能直接接上，必须先问新读数对应谁、包含什么。
edits.en: This need not be attributed to concealment. The old system's electricity, machines, and hash power had no naturally complete inventory either. The new system adds staking services, builders, organizations, and contracts. Once the roles change, the old readings cannot simply be spliced onto the new ones: one must first ask whom each reading represents and what it includes.
edits.reason: Preserve changed measurement boundaries without a physical-old versus unmeasurable-organizational-new binary.

edits.zh: 算力可以结合区块时间和难度来估算。而一个实体控制多少质押，还要借助地址标签等材料识别；两种读数都有各自的推算环节。
edits.en: Hashrate can be estimated using block timing together with difficulty. Identifying how much stake an entity controls requires evidence such as address labels. Both readings have their own inferential steps.
edits.reason: Keep the closing hash-rate description consistent with reviewed EP13 and EP18 section4; difficulty alone is not a precise contemporary census.

edits.zh: 矿场可以读电表，验证节点也可以读电表；难的是从分散的样本推到全网，知道多少设备、承载多少任务，以及该把多少用电算给这一条链。
edits.en: A mining site can have its meter read, and so can a validating node. The difficulty is extrapolating distributed samples to the whole network: how many devices run, how many tasks they carry, and how much electricity should be allocated to this chain.
edits.reason: Both systems have local meters; global estimation is the issue.

edits.zh: 以太坊工作量证明时期的区块奖励和费用收入，可以从区块与状态记录核对，不是通过比特币式的币基交易发放。要看一个矿工真正到手多少，还得考虑矿池分配、费用和成本；要看一个质押者到手多少，也得看服务商抽成和提议、证明等任务的收益。链上总收入和人的净收入，在两边都不是同一回事。
edits.en: Ethereum's proof-of-work block rewards and fee income can be checked in block and state records; they were not paid through Bitcoin-style coinbase transactions. A miner's actual take-home income also depends on pool allocation, fees, and costs. A staker's depends on provider commissions and rewards from proposing, attesting, and other duties. Gross on-chain income and a person's net income are different on both sides.
edits.reason: Correct Ethereum reward mechanism and asymmetric gross/net comparison.

edits.zh: 协议把时间划成每 12 秒一个时隙、每 32 个时隙一个纪元；正常条件下，检查点大约经过两个纪元达到最终确定。时隙可以空缺，最终确定也可能延迟，不能把固定的时间结构说成四年来每次都准时完成、从未出错。
edits.en: The protocol divides time into twelve-second slots and thirty-two-slot epochs. Under normal conditions, a checkpoint reaches finality after about two epochs. Slots may be missed and finality may be delayed. A fixed time structure is not a certificate that every checkpoint finalized on schedule without an error for four years.
edits.reason: Finality is conditional; fixed slots do not guarantee uninterrupted punctual finalization.

edits.zh: 这一点在前面十八篇里已经出现过很多次。但这里有一个特别之处：三条轴上都有可以分别核对的具体安排，而一个答案不能替另外两个作保证。
edits.en: This distinction has appeared many times in the preceding eighteen episodes. What is distinctive here is that each axis contains concrete arrangements that can be checked separately, while an answer on one axis cannot guarantee the answers on the other two.
edits.reason: Complementary questions, not all-perfectly-known independent numerical axes.

edits.zh: 前面几篇里，不好核对的东西往往是那个真正要紧的东西：一个人的损失，一个县的就业，一次转账背后是谁。这一次，合约、参数和一部分费用流确实在链上；但钥匙背后的实际控制人、法律权利和企业净利润，还需要链外材料。三条轴可以分开问，不等于三条轴上的一切都已完全公开。
edits.en: In earlier episodes, what was hard to check was often what mattered most: one person's loss, employment in a county, or who stood behind a transfer. Here, contracts, parameters, and some fee flows really are on-chain. Actual key controllers, legal rights, and net business profits still require off-chain evidence. The three axes can be examined separately without everything on them being completely public.
edits.reason: Separate on-chain observables from entity attribution, legal entitlement and net income.

edits.zh: 它不只藏在哪一条轴上。合约、阈值和部分资金流可以逐项查，实际控制与法律安排则还要另外核实；而把这些不同问题一口气压成一个标签，正是这里最容易漏看的动作。
edits.en: It is not confined to one axis. Contracts, thresholds, and some money flows can be inspected item by item; actual control and legal arrangements require further checking. The easily missed move is compressing these different questions into a single label.
edits.reason: Keep the conclusion consistent with limits on full on-chain observability.

edits.zh: 并没有真正的矛盾。把足够的数据放上链，和确认一项状态主张，是两件事：前者让其他人有材料重建和核查，后者则要看相应的证明或争议机制。在乐观路线里，争议期内没有未解决的有效挑战，还依赖数据可用、证明系统和挑战者等条件；不是时间到了就证明任何错误都不可能存在。
edits.en: There is no real contradiction. Publishing sufficient data and confirming a state claim are different things. The former gives others the material to reconstruct and check; the latter depends on the relevant proof or dispute mechanism. For an optimistic system, reaching the end of the challenge period without an unresolved valid challenge still depends on data availability, the proof system, and challengers. Elapsed time does not prove that no error could exist.
edits.reason: Do not turn an assumption-dependent challenge mechanism into an unconditional correctness guarantee.

edits.zh: 前者通常可以在分钟量级完成；在这里讨论的乐观路线里，后者还要走完相应的争议程序。
edits.en: The first can ordinarily happen on a timescale of minutes. Under the optimistic route discussed here, the second must also pass through the relevant dispute process.
edits.reason: Waiting-window account is specific to optimistic designs, not every L2.

edits.zh: 用户也不一定走第二条路。有人把钱换进来、在里面使用，离开时选择第三方桥，而不是规范桥。这样换来的速度，往往对应另一组资金和验证安排。
edits.en: Users do not necessarily take that second route. Some bring funds in, use them on L2, and leave through a third-party bridge rather than the canonical bridge. The speed gained often relies on a different set of capital and verification arrangements.
edits.reason: No population share is established for canonical versus third-party exits.

edits.zh: 对选择这条快路的用户，大家争论最多的那个争议窗口，就不是他这次直接等待的那段路。
edits.en: For someone choosing that faster route, the much-discussed dispute window is not the waiting period they directly experience on that transfer.
edits.reason: Preserve example without claiming most users never used canonical withdrawal.

edits.zh: 第二层往往要等几分钟，第三层则还要看证明与争议程序。不同界面对这些状态展示得并不一样；一个绿色标记本身，不能替这三层分别作答。
edits.en: The second layer often takes minutes; the third also depends on proof and dispute procedures. Interfaces differ in how they show those states. A green check mark alone cannot answer separately for all three layers.
edits.reason: Do not claim all interfaces hide distinctions or all third-stage finality takes days.

edits.zh: 这也是界面的一个真实设计难题：怎样让日常操作足够简单，同时告诉用户，他看到的是排序器确认、第一层数据确定，还是已经可执行的提款。简化展示，不该让不同承诺变成同一个承诺。
edits.en: This is a real interface-design problem: how to keep everyday use simple while explaining whether the user sees a sequencer confirmation, finalized L1 data, or an executable withdrawal. A simpler display should not turn different promises into one promise.
edits.reason: Remove unsupported claims about inevitable user rejection and designer motive.

edits.zh: 如果界面优先显示第一层的软确认，那一层仍然依赖排序器的运行和承诺；排序器可能暂停、重新排序或发生故障。
edits.en: If an interface emphasizes the first layer's soft confirmation, that layer still depends on the sequencer's operation and promises. The sequencer may stop, reorder transactions, or fail.
edits.reason: Conditional interface description rather than a universal practice.

edits.zh: 而这也决定了这条路线的成本结构：数据需要获得第一层的数据可用性保障，发布数据的价格因此曾是主要成本之一。2024 年3 月 Dencun 升级中的 EIP-4844 引入了 blob 数据市场，降低的正是这一块成本；这不是第十八篇讨论的 2022 年 Merge。
edits.en: This also shapes the cost structure: data need L1 availability guarantees, making data publication one of the major costs. EIP-4844 in the March 2024 Dencun upgrade introduced the blob data market and reduced this component. That was not the 2022 Merge discussed in Episode 18.
edits.reason: Correct Merge/Dencun cross-reference; avoid unverified universal one-to-two-order reduction magnitude.

edits.zh: 因此，这里变便宜的主要是数据发布这一段，不能把它直接说成虚拟机执行每一步都因此变便宜了。
edits.en: What became cheaper here was primarily the data-publication leg. That cannot simply be restated as every step of virtual-machine execution becoming cheaper as a result.
edits.reason: Preserve data cost versus execution cost distinction after correcting upgrade identity.

edits.zh: Arbitrum 的对应路径更加显式。正常情况下交易进入排序器收件箱；绕过排序器时，可以把消息写入以太坊上的延迟收件箱。本文所引的一份配置材料列出 86,400 秒、5,760 个区块；延迟参数和判定规则会随部署版本变化，实际强制包含条件仍要看相应链上合约和文档时点。
edits.en: Arbitrum’s route is more explicit. Transactions normally enter the sequencer inbox; bypass messages can enter the delayed inbox on Ethereum. One configuration document cited here lists 86,400 seconds and 5,760 blocks. Delay parameters and decision rules vary by deployment version; actual force-inclusion conditions depend on the relevant on-chain contracts and documentation date.
edits.reason: Do not portray a version-specific documented configuration as a universally current default; current official pages list differing block parameters.

edits.zh: 官方文档还描述了一套审查超时机制，可以在检测到持续问题时缩短等待。在所引的正常配置和第一层可用等条件下，约 24 小时是理解这条强制包含路径的重要时间尺度，而不是所有故障情境下都保证完成提款的期限。
edits.en: Official documentation also describes a censorship-timeout mechanism that can shorten the wait when persistent problems are detected. Under the cited normal configuration and conditions such as L1 availability, roughly twenty-four hours is an important timescale for this force-inclusion path, not a guarantee that withdrawals finish within that period under every failure scenario.
edits.reason: Configured inclusion delay is conditional and differs from end-to-end withdrawal latency.

edits.zh: 把这一段和第五节接起来读：排序器的拖延不是毫无限制的，规则为绕过它设了时钟；但时钟能不能走完，还依赖第一层、派生规则和后续流程确实运行。
edits.en: Read this together with Section 5: the sequencer's delay is not unlimited, because the rules put a clock on the bypass route. Completing that route still depends on L1, derivation rules, and subsequent processes actually operating.
edits.reason: Avoid unconditional cannot-outlast-clock promise.

edits.zh: 这就是第一条轴和第二条轴在参数里的区别。控制权是真的，写在合约里的绕行条件也是真的；但要判断它给了用户多大的退出保障，还得把这些条件和依赖一起读。
edits.en: That is the distinction between the first and second axes in actual parameters. The control is real, and so are the bypass conditions written into the contract. Assessing the exit protection they give users requires reading those conditions together with their dependencies.
edits.reason: Preserve meaningful operator constraints without unconditional wall-clock guarantee.

edits.zh: 如果重建所需的数据不可获得，状态证明仍可能验证通过，但缺少那些材料的用户就无法只靠那份证明重建自己的余额和退出路径。证明计算正确，和让用户拿得到所需数据，仍然是两件事。
edits.en: If the data needed for reconstruction are unavailable, a state proof may still verify, while users lacking those materials cannot reconstruct their balances and exit paths from that proof alone. Proving a computation correct and making the required data available to users remain different things.
edits.reason: Unavailable to some users does not imply nobody anywhere can reconstruct state.

edits.zh: 所以，真正以 rollup 方式运行的系统，仍要在 Ethereum 提供足够的数据可用性。所谓零知识，并不是数据可以不存在；而且有效性证明也不一定把所有交易细节都隐藏起来。要看具体系统公开的是交易、状态差分，还是其他足以重建的材料。
edits.en: A system genuinely operating as a rollup therefore still needs sufficient data availability on Ethereum. Zero knowledge does not mean the data may not exist, and a validity proof does not necessarily hide every transaction detail. The particular system may publish transactions, state differences, or other material sufficient for reconstruction.
edits.reason: Distinguish validity from privacy and sufficient reconstruction data from every raw transaction.

edits.zh: 两条路线因此在这一点上相同：都需要让用户取得足以核查、重建状态和使用退出路径的数据；具体公开的形式可以不同，不能一概说成完整的原始交易细节。
edits.en: The two routes share this requirement: users need access to enough data to check and reconstruct state and use exit paths. The published form can differ; it cannot always be described as every detail of the raw transactions.
edits.reason: Validity rollups may publish state differences rather than all raw transaction data.

edits.zh: 第六篇里那次分叉争论的，正是后一件事。那里有公开的讨论和各方选择；这里则要逐个看治理委员会、多签和时间锁。有的权限可以很快行使，有的会给用户留下等待和退出的窗口。
edits.en: The fork in Episode 6 concerned that second question. It involved public discussion and choices among participants. Here, one must inspect each governance council, multisig, and timelock. Some powers can be exercised quickly; others leave users a waiting and exit window.
edits.reason: Remove undefined tens-of-thousands debate count and universal within-minutes multisig timing.

edits.zh: 这五起事故的公开材料，都没有报告因此发生资产被盗或最终证明系统接受错误状态。这个共同点要保留，但它不等于用户没有承受等待、回滚或错过交易的损失。
edits.en: The public material on these five incidents reported neither resulting asset theft nor acceptance of an incorrect state by the final proof system. That common point matters, but it does not mean users suffered no harm from waiting, rollbacks, or missed transactions.
edits.reason: Retain project-report evidence level and distinguish technical asset integrity from all user loss.

edits.zh: 按这些事故报告，没有人通过它们盗走资金，最终的证明系统也没有因此接受错误状态。但每一起都曾使普通的第二层操作停下来，用户不能像平时那样提交或完成交易。
edits.en: According to those incident reports, no one used these failures to steal funds and the final proof systems did not accept incorrect states because of them. Each nevertheless interrupted ordinary L2 operation, leaving users unable to submit or complete transactions as usual.
edits.reason: Avoid unlimited claim users could do nothing at all, including all alternative L1 paths.

edits.zh: 这也不是只有早期试验才会遇到的事。五起列举的事故里，四起发生在 2023 年及以后，那时这些链已经承载真实资金和真实业务。这个清单说明风险确实发生过，却不能在没有完整观察期和样本的情况下，替它算出发生概率。
edits.en: Nor is this confined to early experiments. Four of the five listed incidents occurred in 2023 or later, when these chains carried real funds and activity. The list establishes that the risk occurred; without a complete observation period and sample, it cannot establish its probability.
edits.reason: Selected incidents do not supply outage frequency; clarify inclusive2023 timing.

edits.zh: 这里查到的事故材料，主要提供了技术解释和修复安排，并没有同时给出可逐项核对的用户赔偿承诺。至于具体服务是否另有 SLA、适用什么可用性义务，还要看合同、主体和法域，不能只凭事故公告没有写，就说三样在整个领域里都不存在。
edits.en: The incident materials examined here mainly provide technical explanations and remediation plans, without a corresponding itemized promise of user compensation. Whether particular services have separate SLAs or availability duties depends on contracts, entities, and jurisdictions. Their absence from an incident announcement does not prove all three arrangements are absent across the field.
edits.reason: Do not infer universal absence of legal or contractual duties from examined reports.

edits.zh: 这些报告的质量往往很高：根因、时间线、修正和后续计划都讲得清楚。但技术说明和用户的救济是两件事，前者写得详细，并不自动回答后者。
edits.en: The reports are often of high quality, clearly explaining causes, timelines, fixes, and follow-up plans. Technical explanation and user remedies are nevertheless different questions. Detail in the former does not automatically answer the latter.
edits.reason: Preserve accountability question without claiming all reports permanently end every remedy.

edits.zh: 第一件是最终状态的安全，第二件是日常使用的可用性。它们不是同一个指标：证明和结算可以锚定 Ethereum，日常排序则仍依赖第二层运营；绕行和恢复路径又有各自的等待条件。
edits.en: The first is final-state security; the second is availability in everyday use. They are different metrics. Proofs and settlement can be anchored to Ethereum while daily sequencing still depends on L2 operations, with separate waiting conditions for bypass and recovery paths.
edits.reason: Do not deny L1-derived bypass mechanisms while separating daily operation from settlement security.

edits.zh: 那 116 分钟里的正常服务恢复，实际依赖那家运营公司的排障和修复。这不是说外部人原则上永远无能为力，而是把当时日常使用所依赖的那一层写清楚。
edits.en: Restoring normal service during those 116 minutes depended in practice on the operating company's diagnosis and repair. That does not establish that outside help was impossible in principle. It identifies the layer on which ordinary use then depended.
edits.reason: Observed operator dependence does not prove exclusive technical ability.

edits.zh: 费用金库、治理权限和部分分配规则可以在链上读到；它们有没有形成可执行的法律权利，还要结合链外文件。读懂这些材料，首先要知道自己在找哪一个问题的答案，不能只认那个代币名称。
edits.en: Fee vaults, governance powers, and some distribution rules can be read on-chain. Whether they create an enforceable legal right also requires off-chain documents. Reading these materials begins with knowing which question one is trying to answer, not merely recognizing the token's name.
edits.reason: Legal enforceability is not fully determined by inspecting on-chain contracts alone.

edits.zh: 它不是完全没有材料可查。合约地址、多签阈值、争议窗口和每日部分费用流，都可以逐项核对；但钥匙实际由谁控制、法律权利怎样形成、净利润是多少，还要把链外证据接上。可查的项目不能省，查不到的边界也不能省。
edits.en: It is not a complete absence of evidence. Contract addresses, multisig thresholds, dispute windows, and some daily fee flows can be checked item by item. Actual key control, legal rights, and net profit still require off-chain evidence. Neither the inspectable details nor the limits of inspection should disappear.
edits.reason: Keep conclusion consistent with on-chain versus off-chain observability.

edits.zh: 这不是谁的错。一个人日常使用一条链，不可能每次都重读验证合约、多签名单和费用金库。他可以借助文档、独立评估和解释；重要的是，这些入口也要替他保留三条轴的区别，而不是再压回一个好听的标签。
edits.en: This is no one's fault. A person using a chain every day cannot reread its verifier contract, multisig membership, and fee vault each time. Documentation, independent assessments, and explanations can help. Those entry points must still preserve the distinction among the three axes rather than compress them back into an attractive label.
edits.reason: Independent information channels exist, including the assessor cited in this essay.

edits.zh: 当短期国债的收益率从接近零回到 4%—5% 的水平时，一个可以放在链上，可以被合约调用，同时又能拿到国债收益的东西，有了更明确的经济吸引力。第八篇里那笔储备收益归发行人所有的账，在这里换了个方向：如果那份收益可以直接落到持有人手上，那么它就多了一份被搬上链的理由。
edits.en: When short-term Treasury yields returned from near zero to a level of 4–5%, something that could sit on-chain, interact with contracts and also earn Treasury income gained a clearer economic attraction. Episode 8 examined reserve income accruing to an issuer. Here the direction changes: if that income reaches holders directly, it adds a reason to bring the product on-chain.
edits.reason: Yield level4–5%, not change of4–5percentagepoints; avoid declaring first-ever economic rationale.

edits.zh: 这一句是这一整段历史里很实在的一处提醒。区分在最坏的那一天尤其会产生后果，平时的转让资格和赎回也会受它影响；而一个相似的余额界面，本身并不足以告诉你自己买的是哪一种。还要去读产品说明和法律文件。
edits.en: This is a practical warning running through the history. The distinction matters especially on the worst day, but also affects ordinary transfer eligibility and redemption. A similar-looking balance screen does not by itself tell you which structure you bought. Product descriptions and legal documents still need to be read.
edits.reason: No universal absence of disclosures/interfaces; distinctions matter before insolvency too.

edits.zh: 第三篇里那家交易所倒掉之前，屏幕上也有余额。可是能显示一笔余额，不等于已经证明背后有足额资产，更不等于已经说明那笔权利的法律位置。
edits.en: Before the exchange in Episode 3 collapsed, its screens displayed balances too. Displaying a balance did not establish full asset backing, much less identify the legal position of the claim.
edits.reason: Displayed balances not certified universally correct.

edits.zh: 而链上转移的，是投资者手里那一层 OUSG 合伙权益，不是底下每一张国债。
edits.en: What moves on-chain is the investor’s layer of OUSG partnership interests, not each Treasury security underneath.
edits.reason: Clarify investornode versus firstassetlayer in four-node example.

edits.zh: 这些层次各有自己的作用；而叠起来之后，链上那一格与底下那张国债之间，隔着不止一层法律关系。这里的具体路径，是 OUSG 合伙权益，经由 BUIDL 基金份额，再到底层资产。
edits.en: Each layer serves a purpose. Stacked together, they put more than one legal relationship between the on-chain entry and the Treasury security underneath. The particular route here runs from OUSG partnership interests through BUIDL fund shares to the underlying assets.
edits.reason: Four nodes not fouredges; preserve concrete multilayer example without false universal count.

edits.zh: 这些层次不必然是设计缺陷，但也不是所有代币化产品都必经的同样四步。前面的 Franklin 基金结构就不同。要问的是：这一只产品为什么这样接，每一层究竟给了持有人什么权利。
edits.en: Those layers are not necessarily a design flaw, nor are the same four steps inevitable for every tokenized product. The Franklin fund described above uses a different structure. The questions are why this product is connected this way and what rights each layer gives its holder.
edits.reason: Specific architecture not universal legal necessity.

edits.zh: 每一层都要分别看合同、适用法律和可以追究的义务；是否负有受托责任，也不能只凭它在这条链上的位置一概认定。
edits.en: At each layer, the contracts, applicable law and enforceable obligations must be examined separately. Whether fiduciary duties apply cannot be inferred simply from a role’s place in this chain.
edits.reason: Do not impose uniform fiduciary duties on every role.

edits.zh: 这个设计有很实际的理由。逐笔办理贷款让与，依合同和法域不同，可能要通知借款人、更新担保登记，有时还要重新取得同意；如果每一次二级市场买卖都重走这些程序，流通成本就会大得多。
edits.en: The design has a practical rationale. Depending on the contract and jurisdiction, individual loan assignments may require notice to borrowers, updates to security registrations or renewed consent. Repeating those procedures for every secondary-market trade would make circulation much more costly.
edits.reason: Jurisdiction/instrument-dependent assignment requirements; preserve cost mechanism.

edits.zh: 转让代理可以更正错误交易、限制转让，并管理钱包白名单。这里的更正，并不是删除旧区块里的交易：招股书说明，可以在后续区块追加指令，让登记状态反映更正，而原来的交易历史仍然留下。
edits.en: The transfer agent can correct erroneous transactions, restrict transfers and manage wallet whitelists. Correction here does not mean deleting a transaction from an old block. The prospectus explains that an instruction can be added in a later block to update the registration state while retaining the original transaction history.
edits.reason: Root verified2026Franklin prospectus: append correction instructions, no deletion of prior history.

edits.zh: 这不是批评者写的。这是发行人在面向投资者的法定披露文件里，明确写下来的。
edits.en: A critic did not write this. The issuer states it explicitly in the statutory disclosure document provided to investors.
edits.reason: Disclosure source clear; no unproved claim regulatory duties voluntary.

edits.zh: 它放下的，是链上一次转移就能无条件决定法律权利归属的想法；不是让过去的区块历史可以被任意删除。
edits.en: What it sets aside is the idea that an on-chain transfer unconditionally determines legal entitlement, not the protection against arbitrary deletion of past block history.
edits.reason: Separate immutable event history from correctable registration state/legal rights.

edits.zh: 这和前面几篇碰到的是同一条边界。第一篇区分了链上转账和外面的披萨；第六篇的分叉争论涉及怎样回应已经执行的状态；第十一篇里，有些拍卖按代码走完，却没有形成预期的竞争。链能记下发生过什么，不等于它单独决定这些事情在别的规则里算什么。
edits.en: This is the same boundary encountered earlier. Episode 1 distinguished an on-chain transfer from the pizza outside it. Episode 6’s fork dispute concerned how to respond to an executed state. In Episode 11, some auctions completed under the code without producing the expected competition. Recording what happened does not mean the chain alone determines what it counts as under other rules.
edits.reason: Keep cross-episode examples aligned with frozen1/6/11; nearzeroauctions notnobids atall.

edits.zh: 而这一次，发行人预先声明：链上记录了一次转移，不一定就让收币者取得基金份额的法律权利。是否还产生返还或赔偿等别的法律后果，要另看事实和适用法律。
edits.en: Here the issuer states in advance that a recorded on-chain transfer does not necessarily give the recipient legal rights to fund shares. Whether it produces other consequences, such as restitution or liability, depends on the facts and applicable law.
edits.reason: No fundshare entitlement does not mean no legal consequences whatsoever.

edits.zh: 这句声明写在一份面向普通投资者的招股说明书里。它把错误发生后怎样识别有效登记、谁有权作出更正，先摆到了买家面前。仅凭这份声明，不能断定它与监管要求无关，也不能替发行人认定唯一的写作动机。
edits.en: The statement appears in a prospectus addressed to ordinary investors. It tells buyers beforehand how valid registration is identified after an error and who may correct it. The statement alone establishes neither that regulation played no part nor the issuer’s sole reason for including it.
edits.reason: No unsupported absenceofregulation or soleissuer motive; preserve practical disclosure role.

edits.zh: 一笔在链上完成、被区块确认、可以回查的转账，仍可能不足以让收币者取得那份基金权益。交易发生过，与法律上有效取得了什么，是两个问题。
edits.en: A transfer completed on-chain, confirmed in a block and available for inspection may still be insufficient to give its recipient the fund interest. Whether the transaction occurred and what was legally acquired are different questions.
edits.reason: No universal everlastingallnodes/noeffect wording; preserve event-vslegalclaim distinction.

edits.zh: 这一条和第十二篇里那个 204 条 a 款正好相照。那一次，链上交易可以有密码学签名，却不等于已经满足著作权让与对书面形式和权利人有效签署的要求。这一次，发行人事先写明：链上记录如何进入正式登记、错误如何更正，要按产品文件和适用法律来认定，不只凭代币已经转走。
edits.en: This echoes Section 204(a) in Episode 12. There, a transaction could carry a cryptographic signature without necessarily satisfying the requirements for a written copyright conveyance validly signed by the rights holder. Here the issuer states in advance that how an on-chain record enters the official register, and how errors are corrected, depends on the product documents and applicable law—not merely on the token having moved.
edits.reason: Synchronize frozenEP12; issuerrecordnotunconditional legal supremacy.

edits.zh: 要让一个登记系统长期承载养老金，就要说明：错误登记、继承和司法命令该怎样处理。保留旧记录，与允许依法更正当前权利状态，并不冲突。
edits.en: For a registration system to hold pension assets over the long term, it must explain how errors, inheritance and court orders are handled. Keeping the old record is compatible with lawfully correcting the current state of rights.
edits.reason: No technicalimpossibility from immutablehistory; corrections can be appendonly.

edits.zh: 一个人去世之后，他的股票可以依继承程序转到继承人手里，而不必由死者再签一次字。登记机构怎样更新名册，要有有效文件、权限和法律程序作依据；不只因为某个人能改那本册子。
edits.en: After a person dies, shares can pass to heirs through succession procedures without a new signature from the deceased. Updating the register requires valid documents, authority and legal procedures—not merely someone with the technical ability to alter the book.
edits.reason: Transferagentrole notuniversalsolecause; lawfulauthorityvsarbitrarywriteaccess.

edits.zh: 而在处理一份要延续三十年、经过继承、离婚、破产和法院命令的财产权利时，只留下不可删除的旧记录还不够。系统还要能记下合法的更正和后续变化。
edits.en: For property rights lasting thirty years through inheritance, divorce, bankruptcy and court orders, an undeletable record of past events is not enough. The system must also record lawful corrections and later changes.
edits.reason: Historyimmutability not itself obstacle; distinguish state transitions.

edits.zh: 所以，这些产品不是先把历史不可删除交回去，而是把谁能更新登记、什么条件下可以更新，重新放进法律和可追责的程序。
edits.en: These products do not start by giving up an undeletable history. They put the authority to update registration, and the conditions for doing so, within law and accountable procedures.
edits.reason: Root requested linkedcorrection ofabandonimmutability refrain.

edits.zh: 而重新写明的不只是更正权。本文这些产品中的白名单限制准入，申购赎回时间服从相应业务安排，合格投资者门槛限制谁能参加，链外身份数据库把钱包接回现实中的人。这些限制也不能一概说成每一种代币化资产都完全相同。
edits.en: Correction authority is not the only condition made explicit again. In the products discussed here, whitelists restrict entry, subscriptions and redemptions follow their business arrangements, investor qualifications limit participation, and off-chain identity databases connect wallets to real people. These restrictions are not identical across every tokenized asset.
edits.reason: Product-specific constraints notuniversal propertyrenunciation; retainall4examples.

edits.zh: 而本文分开的两类产品，权利结构也常不同：一类主要承诺固定面额的兑付，另一类代表基金份额，或者别的底层权利。第八篇写过前一类。把它们混成一个总数，会遮住收益、风险和兑付机制的区别；这不等于所有 RWA 都是基金份额。
edits.en: The two groups separated here also often have different rights structures. One principally promises redemption at a fixed face amount; another represents fund shares or other underlying rights. Episode 8 examined the former. Combining them in one total can obscure differences in income, risk and redemption, but this does not make every RWA a fund share.
edits.reason: RWAincludesgold/property/privatecredit,notallfundshares; scope stablecoinliability classification.

edits.zh: 它们各有自己的收录范围和算法，不能因为都能追到数据商，就认定已经互相校验。以 111 亿为分母，156.4 亿比它高约 40.9%；这个差距首先提醒我们，两个总数不能脱离口径直接并用。
edits.en: Each has its own coverage and method; traceability to a data provider is not mutual validation. Using 11.1 billion as the denominator, 15.64 billion is about 40.9% higher. The gap first reminds us not to combine the totals without their definitions.
edits.reason: Arithmetic40.9not45%; noautomaticbothfigurescertifiedcorrect.

edits.zh: 前一只是面向机构等合格投资者的资金管理工具，后一只则让符合条件的普通个人也能用手机购买。覆盖这两只产品的行业统计，可以把它们的净值加在同一个总额里，却不会因此显示两边的参与者有什么不同。
edits.en: The former is a cash-management tool for institutions and other eligible investors; the latter also lets eligible ordinary individuals buy through a phone. An industry total covering both can add their net asset values without showing how different their participants are.
edits.reason: Not everyindustrydatasetincludesall; institutionsnotexclusiveallqualifiedpurchasers.

edits.zh: 而第六节会说明，现有材料还不足以把一些产品更方便、更小额的购买方式，推成普通人可及性已经普遍扩大的结论。
edits.en: Section 6 shows why existing material is insufficient to turn easier, smaller purchases in some products into a conclusion that access has broadly expanded for ordinary people.
edits.reason: No absentbenefit inference fromlackcausal evidence; acknowledge existingretailaccess.

edits.zh: 第二件需要另外的证据：新增了哪些投资者，进来的钱是否只是从别处搬来，以及他们原来为什么进不来。现有材料还不能把这些问题完整量出来。
edits.en: The second requires separate evidence: which investors are new, whether funds were simply moved from elsewhere, and why those investors previously could not enter. Existing material does not yet measure those questions fully.
edits.reason: Newcapitalnotidenticalneweligibility; bounded evidencegap.

edits.zh: 第十九篇拆过四种最终性，区分的是排序确认、数据落到第一层、状态确认和出金可执行。这一次的问题跨得更远：转得动、找得到买家、证券权利已经转移、银行现金也已结清，分别牵涉技术、市场、法律和支付安排，不能只用一个时钟。
edits.en: Episode 19 separated sequencing confirmation, data inclusion on Layer 1, state confirmation and executable withdrawals. The present questions span farther: whether a token can move, a buyer can be found, legal securities rights have transferred and bank cash has settled. They involve technical, market, legal and payment arrangements, not one clock.
edits.reason: Fourquestionsnotfouridenticalfinalities; preservepriorchapteractualaxes.

edits.zh: 一个东西即使 20 美元就能买，也还要问谁有资格买、从哪里买，以及想卖时有没有对手方。金额门槛降低，是一种改善；它本身还不能证明别的门槛也已经打开。
edits.en: Even if something costs only 20 dollars to buy, we must still ask who is eligible, where it can be bought and whether a counterparty exists when selling. Lowering the monetary threshold is an improvement; it does not establish that the other gates are open.
edits.reason: Do not equatefewholdingaddresseswithfeweligiblepeople; preserveaccess critique.

edits.zh: 降低的是金额门槛。资格门槛是否改变，要按产品分别看；对仍只面向合格购买人的那一类，低面额不会自动取消那道门。
edits.en: The monetary threshold has fallen. Whether eligibility has changed depends on the product. For products still limited to qualified purchasers, a small denomination does not automatically remove that gate.
edits.reason: RetailFranklinandprivatefundnotconflate.

edits.zh: 某只基金当前只有几十个持有地址，而且仍然要求合格购买人资格。前者是观察到的参与，后者是法律上的准入条件；几十个地址既不等于几十个自然人，也不等于全世界只有几十个人有资格购买。
edits.en: One fund currently has only a few dozen holding addresses and still requires qualified-purchaser status. The first describes observed participation; the second describes legal eligibility. A few dozen addresses means neither a few dozen natural persons nor that only a few dozen people worldwide are eligible.
edits.reason: Keep reportedaddressesandqualification, explicitlyseparatedenominators.

edits.zh: 第一类已经有不少答案了。第二类，在本次检索范围里还没有找到事实模式直接相合的公开判决。没有找到，不等于从来没有人提起过这样的争议。
edits.en: The first category already has many answers. For the second, this search found no published judgment directly matching the facts. Not finding one does not mean such a dispute has never been raised.
edits.reason: Bounded negativecase-lawsearch notuniversalabsence.

edits.zh: 这处空白本身不能说明没有发生过足够大的冲突。争议可能和解，也可能没有形成已公开的判决；本次材料不足以把这些可能逐一排除。
edits.en: That gap does not establish that no sufficiently large conflict has occurred. Disputes may settle or produce no published judgment. The material reviewed here cannot exclude those possibilities one by one.
edits.reason: No publicationnotproofnoconflict; nospeculativegoodnewsconclusion.

edits.zh: 而现在关于以哪一份记录为准的分析，仍有成文法、监管材料和发行文件这些现实依据。需要保留的限定是：怎样把它们用到一场具体冲突，还缺少本次找到的、事实直接相合的公开判例来检验。
edits.en: Current analysis of which record governs still has real foundations in statutes, regulatory materials and offering documents. The qualification is that this search found no directly matching published precedent testing their application to the specific conflict.
edits.reason: Lawnotmerelypaperuntilfirstlitigation.

edits.zh: 某一天，如果有人把链上的记录和一份内容不同的股东名册一起带进法庭，判决会让这种适用更具体。但在那之前，也不能把已经适用的法律和合同当成没有答案。
edits.en: If someone brings an on-chain record and a conflicting shareholder register into court, a judgment may make that application more concrete. Until then, however, existing law and contracts should not be treated as providing no answers.
edits.reason: Preservecourtroomimagewithoutalllawvoidpendingtestcase.

edits.zh: 而第三节那一句，是这里很具体的一条产品披露：发行人写明，错误收币的一方不会因此取得基金份额的法律请求权。它让买家事先知道这只产品怎样安排登记与更正，却不高于适用法律。
edits.en: The sentence in Section 3 is a concrete product disclosure: the issuer says erroneous token receipt does not itself create a legal claim to fund shares. It tells buyers in advance how this product handles registration and correction, but does not outrank applicable law.
edits.reason: Issuerprospectusimportantdisclosurenotlegalsupremacy.

edits.zh: 它的价值，正在于一方在纠纷发生之前就公开了自己的安排，买家在购买前可以读到。但条款是否有效、怎样适用，发生争议时仍由适用法律和有管辖权的机构来判断；不能因为是发行人写的，就比法院更有最后效力。
edits.en: Its value is that a party disclosed its arrangements before a dispute and buyers can read them before purchasing. The validity and application of the terms still fall under applicable law and competent authorities. Being written by the issuer does not give them greater final authority than a court.
edits.reason: Keepprecontractdisclosurepointwithoutinvertedauthorityhierarchy.

edits.zh: 投资者这一侧付出的是资金，得到的是相应的法律权利凭证；在产品条款和技术权限允许的范围内，它还可以被链上转让、用作抵押，或者组合进别的合约。这几项能力也要逐只产品核实。
edits.en: Investors provide funds and receive the corresponding legal rights instrument. Within the product’s terms and technical permissions, it may also be transferred on-chain, used as collateral or combined with other contracts. Those capabilities must be checked product by product.
edits.reason: Notallregulatedtokensfreelycomposableorpledgeable.

edits.zh: 发行方与服务商这一侧，可能分别取得代币化服务费、转让代理费、基金行政费、集成费和维护费。这些角色和收费可能重合，也可能不全出现；已经列出的收费，是实际成本的一部分，不能先当成一笔笔被节省掉的成本。
edits.en: Issuers and service providers may receive tokenization, transfer-agency, fund-administration, integration and maintenance fees. Roles and charges can overlap, and not every product has them all. Listed charges form part of actual cost; they cannot simply be counted in advance as costs saved.
edits.reason: Avoiduniversalallfivefeesadded/doublecount; keepcostscrutiny.

edits.zh: 所以，问题不只在于有没有写下来，也在于这些条款是否足够可得、能否被读懂，以及买家有没有真正看见它们。披露重要，却不是对实际理解的保证。
edits.en: The question is not only whether terms were written down, but whether they are accessible and understandable and whether buyers actually see them. Disclosure matters, but does not guarantee understanding.
edits.reason: Donotreduceallremainingrisksolelyreaderfailure.

edits.zh: 在本文这些不同的产品结构里，转让代理、托管人、投资者资格、营业日与营业时间，又以各自的方式出现了。依法处理错误登记、继承和执行的人，也重新站到了系统里面；不是每一种产品都由同一个角色承担这些事。
edits.en: Across the different product structures examined here, transfer agents, custodians, investor qualifications and business-day arrangements reappear in different forms. So do the people legally responsible for errors, inheritance and enforcement. The same role does not perform all these functions in every product.
edits.reason: Product-specific legalrolesnotuniversalsameagent; preserveinvitationrefrain.

edits.zh: 而把这些安排接进来的，也包括发行方自己的商业选择：去进入受监管的市场，申请相应资格，找服务机构，并在发行文件里写明规则。选择进入，不等于进入之后的牌照、披露和投资者保护义务全是自愿的；它们也来自适用法律。
edits.en: Issuers’ own business choices are part of bringing these arrangements in: entering regulated markets, obtaining the relevant authorizations, appointing service providers and specifying rules in offering documents. Choosing to enter does not make the resulting licensing, disclosure and investor-protection obligations wholly voluntary. They also arise from applicable law.
edits.reason: Businesschoicevsmandatorycompliance; no unsupportedabsenceofregulatorycompulsion.

edits.zh: 这些产品调整的，是无条件准入、不问身份、随时申赎，以及一次链上转移就决定最终权利的想法。它们可以保留不可删除的交易历史，同时让当前登记依法更新；不能把这两件事都压成一句不可篡改被交回去了。
edits.en: These products modify expectations of unconditional entry, unidentified participation, round-the-clock subscription and redemption, and final entitlement determined by one on-chain transfer. They can retain an undeletable transaction history while lawfully updating current registration. Those two facts should not be compressed into a claim that immutability was surrendered.
edits.reason: Linkedimmutablehistoryvsstate/legalrights correction; preserveallproperties.

edits.zh: 说它调整了这些条件，不是说它变节了。一样东西要装下别的东西，总要长出承载它的形状；而承载长期财产权利的形状，既要保留记录，也要说明怎样依法更正。
edits.en: Changing those conditions is not necessarily a betrayal. To carry something else, a system must develop a form capable of supporting it. A form carrying long-term property rights must preserve records and explain how lawful corrections occur.
edits.reason: Keeporiginalliteraryargumentwithoutabandonimmutablehistory.

edits.zh: 要承载养老金，登记系统就要处理错误、继承和司法命令；要承接受托责任，就要能够识别谁负责、向谁负责。这些要求可以叠在保留旧历史的链上，不必把法律上的可更正写成技术上的可删除。
edits.en: To carry pension assets, a register must handle errors, inheritance and court orders. To support fiduciary duties, it must identify who is responsible and to whom. These requirements can be layered onto a chain retaining its old history. Legal correction need not mean technical deletion.
edits.reason: Longtermrights/fiduciarynotimpossibleonappendonlyhistory.

edits.zh: 这个安排在制度上可以自洽。要接住一份可能延续三十年、经过继承和法院命令的财产权利，就要有一条有效的法律程序，能够认定原登记有误，并让后续登记反映这个认定。
edits.en: Such an arrangement can be institutionally coherent. Property rights lasting thirty years through inheritance and court orders need valid legal procedures that can identify an erroneous registration and have subsequent registration reflect that determination.
edits.reason: Processnotarbitrarypersonunilateraloverrides; keep30yearsexample.

edits.zh: 而在这条程序里负有职责的机构和人，应当能够被识别、被追责，并在适用法律下接受监管或司法审查。
edits.en: The institutions and people with duties in that process should be identifiable and accountable, and subject to supervision or judicial review under applicable law.
edits.reason: Scopeaccountabilitytoactuallegalrolesnotuniversaloneagent.

edits.zh: 如果它调整了原来的准入和控制条件，换来承载真实资产的能力，那么这是一笔可以算的交易；而算它的时候，两边都要写上。保留历史与允许合法更正，也要分别记清楚。
edits.en: If adjusting the original access and control conditions enables it to carry real assets, that is a trade-off that can be examined. Both sides must be recorded, and preservation of history distinguished from lawful correction.
edits.reason: Refraincoherentwithappendonlycorrection finding.

edits.zh: 目前的公开材料，已经把不少准入限制、更正权限和服务条件写得很清楚。而换回来的净效果——成本到底降了多少、原来进不来的人多进来了多少——还缺少这里需要的配对测量。产品已经有的具体功能，与整个行业尚未量清的净收益，要分开说。
edits.en: Public materials already specify many access restrictions, correction powers and service conditions. What is still missing here is a matched measurement of the net result: how much costs fell and how many previously excluded people gained entry. Existing product functions should be distinguished from industry-wide net benefits not yet fully measured.
edits.reason: No inferencebenefitsabsent/unknownall; acknowledgefunctionsandmeasurementgap.

edits.zh: 所以现在能说的是：一些代价已经明确列出，一些具体便利也确实存在；而把两边放在一起之后，净收益有多大、由谁得到，还要继续量。
edits.en: What can be said now is that some costs are explicitly listed and some concrete conveniences exist. Once both sides are counted, the size of the net benefit and who receives it still require measurement.
edits.reason: Missingmatchednetbenefitnotproofonlycostsknown.

edits.zh: 底层公开链每天照常出块，记录符合合约条件的转移；但这些产品的合约和服务机构，可以在转移前就核对身份与资格。链的开放性，不等于产品也不问你是谁。
edits.en: The underlying public chain keeps producing blocks and recording transfers that satisfy contract conditions. Product contracts and service providers may check identity and eligibility before a transfer. An open chain does not make every product indifferent to who participates.
edits.reason: Whitelistidentityenforcedatcontractlayer,notuniversalnoidentityatall.

edits.zh: 而在本文这些代币化基金、黄金、贷款和房产安排背后，分别有登记、保管、服务与执行的角色。有的由转让代理维护名册，有的由别的法律实体承担；谁能更正、谁拿着资产、发生冲突时谁有权决定，都要按具体文件和法律去查。
edits.en: Behind the tokenized funds, gold, loans and property structures examined here are different registration, custody, servicing and enforcement roles. Some use a transfer agent to maintain a register; others assign duties to different legal entities. Who may correct a record, who holds the assets and who may decide a dispute must be checked against the specific documents and law.
edits.reason: Noeverytokenhassametransferagent; preservespecificfourassetexamples.

edits.zh: 后面那些层的文件和声明，也可以留下链上记录；但它们是否有效、资产是否还在、权利能否实现，不会只因第一层记得精确就自动得到证明。
edits.en: Documents and declarations from the later layers can also leave on-chain records. But their validity, the continued presence of assets and the enforceability of rights are not automatically established by precision in the first layer.
edits.reason: Rightsdocumentscanrecordonchain; distinguishrecordfromproofratherthanalllaterlayersunrecorded.

metadata.deck: Eine nominale Umrechnungsformel bedeutet nicht, tatsächlich einen Dollar zurückzuerhalten: Wie Ausgabe, Verbrennung, Liquidität und Betriebspausen bei Terra und LUNA verschiedene Ebenen des Versprechens offenlegen.

Une formule de conversion nominale ne garantit pas de récupérer réellement un dollar : comment émissions, destructions, liquidité et suspensions de Terra et LUNA révèlent plusieurs niveaux de promesse.
Korrektheit, Kontrolle und Zahlungsströme sind drei Achsen, die getrennt untersucht werden müssen. Sie zu „Ethereums Sicherheit erben“ zusammenzufassen, verwischt entscheidende Unterschiede.
Correction, contrôle et flux financiers sont trois axes à examiner séparément. Les fondre dans la formule « hériter de la sécurité d’Ethereum » efface des différences essentielles.
Una fórmula de conversión nominal no equivale a recuperar realmente un dólar: cómo la emisión, la quema, la liquidez y las pausas de Terra y LUNA revelan distintos niveles de promesas.
La corrección, el control y los flujos de caja son tres ejes que deben examinarse por separado; reunirlos bajo la expresión «heredar la seguridad de Ethereum» borra diferencias fundamentales.
名义兑换公式不等于实际拿回一美元：Terra 与 Luna 的铸销、流动性和暂停，怎样暴露不同层次的承诺。
名義兌換公式不等於實際拿回一美元：Terra 與 Luna 的鑄銷、流動性和暫停，怎樣暴露不同層次的承諾。
A nominal conversion formula is not a guarantee of getting a dollar back: minting, burning, liquidity, and halts expose different layers of Terra and Luna’s promise.
正确性、控制权与现金流，是需要分别追问的三条轴；把它们合成“继承以太坊安全”，会抹掉关键差异。
正確性、控制權與現金流，是需要分別追問的三條軸；把它們合成「繼承以太坊安全」，會抹掉關鍵差異。
Correctness, control, and cash flow are three axes that need separate examination. Combining them into “inheriting Ethereum’s security” erases crucial differences.
